# Pawgrab

> Web scraping API. Returns clean Markdown, HTML, text, or structured JSON from any URL. Self-hostable, stealth-first: TLS fingerprint impersonation, coherent browser fingerprints, human-like input, proxy escalation, and challenge solving built in.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): Install, configure, and first scrape
- [API reference](api.md): All endpoints with request/response schemas
- [Scraping](scraping.md): Formats, selectors, actions, JS rendering
- [Crawling](crawling.md): Async BFS crawling, jobs, pagination
- [Extraction](extraction.md): CSS/XPath/regex/LLM structured extraction
- [Configuration](configuration.md): Every environment variable
- [Deployment](deployment.md): Docker Compose (API + worker + Redis)
- [CLI](cli.md): pawgrab scrape / extract / serve
- [Architecture](architecture.md): Engine internals

## Endpoints

- POST /v1/scrape: Scrape one URL; formats markdown/html/text/json/csv/xml; options for actions, screenshots, sessions, LLM summary/question/highlights
- POST /v1/parse: Convert raw HTML through the same extraction pipeline without fetching
- POST /v1/crawl: Async site crawl (202 + job polling at GET /v1/crawl/{job_id})
- POST /v1/search: Web search + parallel scraping of results; include_domains/exclude_domains scoping
- POST /v1/extract: LLM extraction with prompt, JSON Schema validation, or auto-schema
- POST /v1/map: Discover URLs of a site
- POST /v1/batch: Batch scrape job
- GET /health: Component health (ok/degraded/unhealthy)

## Optional

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/jaywyawhare/Pawgrab/tree/master/sdk/python): pip install pawgrab-sdk
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/jaywyawhare/Pawgrab/tree/master/sdk/typescript): npm install pawgrab-sdk
